newsitem.title: USA: PSDI, Nets in Internet sales/marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: PSDI, Nets in Internet sales/marketing pact.

text.p: Project Software & Development Inc said Monday it and Nets Inc agreed to jointly develop, market and sell a complete Internet-based solution for buying and selling maintenance, repair and operations supplies.
The terms of the alliance were not disclosed.

Nets, a private company based in Cambridge, Mass., focuses on business-to-business electronic commerce. Its chairman, Jim Manzi, is the former chief executive of Lotus Development Corp, now a unit of International Business Machines Corp.
In order to develop commerce services, PSDI and Nets initially will work with a small number of companies on pilot projects. The companies said they expect to deliver commerce services by year end.

Some of the online services included in the agreement are available immediately, the companies said, including a direct connection to Industry.net from the MAXIMO desktop and the ability to attach electronic catalogs to MAXIMO equipment and spare parts.
MAXIMO is PSDI's maintenance management software.
